name: Affiliate webform
description: Creates affiliate conversions when submissions are made to selected webforms by a visitor carrying an affiliate cookie.
project_description: Affiliate Webform is a submodule of Affiliated that attributes Webform submissions to affiliates. It implements hook_webform_submission_insert and, for each affiliate conversion type whose enabled_webforms third-party setting includes the submitted form, creates an affiliate_conversion crediting the visitor's cookied affiliate with the webform submission as the parent entity. Each conversion type gains an Affiliate Webform fieldset on its form to pick which webforms trigger it and a per-submission value. Requires webform and affiliated. Part of the affiliated project (version dir 1.0.x, 1.0.0-alpha).
